text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Saddam Hussein chairs a meeting of the regional command of the Arab Baath Socialist Party. The meeting decide to relieve minister of labour and social affairs of his post in order to dedicate his time for party work.
- Iraq, Jordan start oil talks in Baghdad.
(The above stories were carried by IRAQ and JUMHOURIYA)
- Egyptian firms to visit Baghdad to sign trade contracts to supply Iraq with foodsuffs and medicine under the oil-for- food deal signed with the United Nations.
- Two oil tankers to arrive at the Iraqi Mina al-Bakr oil terminal next month.
